app.name: Transport controls
app.summary: Media keys, from skip back to eject, each running the Home Assistant action you choose.
app.tile_example: Skip back, stop, play, pause, skip forward and eject
app.key_previous_hint: The action of this key, such as media_player.media_previous_track. Leave it empty to leave the key out.
app.key_stop_hint: Such as media_player.media_stop. Leave it empty to leave the key out.
app.key_play_hint: Such as media_player.media_play. Leave it empty to leave the key out.
app.key_pause_hint: Such as media_player.media_pause. Leave it empty to leave the key out.
app.key_play_pause_hint: Such as media_player.media_play_pause. Leave it empty to leave the key out.
app.key_next_hint: Such as media_player.media_next_track. Leave it empty to leave the key out.
app.key_eject_hint: Such as remote.send_command command=EJECT, or script.turn_on script.eject_disc to act on another entity. Leave it empty to leave the key out.
